note: Committed export surface of the runtime package, pinned by test/index.test.js. Step 5 W0 shipped an empty surface on purpose: the harness exists before any module moves. W1 added loaders, W2 moved the persistence modules without publishing them, and W3 adds orchestrator; each batch adds its namespace to src/index.js and to this list in the same commit, so growing the surface is always a reviewable diff. `loaders` is the eight-name RFC §11.5 table (test/loaders-surface.test.js pins the members); `orchestrator` is the eight entry points of docs/ORCHESTRATOR_ENTRY_POINTS.md (test/orchestrator-index.test.js pins the members and the old-path identity).
